description: Convert a supported document in the workspace to an immutable Markdown resource owned by the current Thread.

propertyDescriptions.path: Workspace-relative document path. Supported types include PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLS/XLSX, CSV, text, Markdown, HTML, JSON, XML, and YAML. Legacy DOC and PPT files are not supported.

guidance: Use read_document for supported workspace documents that read_file cannot decode as UTF-8. It converts a document once and returns a thread-resource:// URI; use read_file on that URI for bounded line ranges. Repeated conversion of unchanged source bytes reuses the existing Thread resource. Use read_image for workspace images.
